scope: Exact adjudication of continued-fraction survivors against a 13k-record prior-art corpus built from independently encoded classical identities and their declared transformation orbits. KNOWN requires an exhibited, re-verified transformation chain to a cited seed. Value equality alone yields INCONCLUSIVE_VALUE_MATCH. NOT_FOUND_IN_CORPUS is absence from a finite corpus and is never a novelty claim.
